content.value: A flexible shaft consists of a 0.45 in Ø steel wire encased in a stationary tube that fits closely enough to impose a frictional torque of 0.38 Ib.in/in. Determine the maximum length of the shaft if the shearing stresses are not allowed to exceed 18 ksi. Determine the angular deformation of one end relative to the other end. Use G $\mathbf { \tau } = 5 \times 1 0 ^ { 6 } \mathsf { p s i } .$
